title: Selfune Decision Record
description: One hiring decision as the employer recorded it (one line of decisions.jsonl). Input to the loop. Describes the process, never the person: candidates are anonymous references only.

candidate_ref.description: Anonymous ID only. Never a name.

reason_text.description: The stated reason, in the employer's words.

fields_missing.description: Application fields that were empty. An empty field is a fact, not evidence about the applicant (C06).

decided_by.description: Optional. If absent, C11 reports NOT_CHECKED: a solely automated decision can't be ruled out.

tools_used.description: Optional. tool_ids that produced input to this decision. C09 blocks the chain only when a C09-flagged tool is listed here. If absent, tool flags stay job-level issues.
